# CarouselPulse — Implementation Tasks & Design Notes

## Source & Mapping

- **ColorLib Source**: `carousel-11` (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-11/`)
- **Live Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bootstrap/carousel-11/`
- **Assigned App Name**: `carouselpulse` (`apps/carouselpulse`)

## Design & Layout Notes

- Clean minimalist showcase centered in a responsive container.
- Large photo slider with prev/next chevron controls and subtle bottom dot pagination.
- Typography: Roboto font family.
- Color palette: Deep neutral background, crisp white headings, muted gray subtext, high-contrast image frames.

## Section Order

1. **Header / Title**: Centered section title ("Carousel #1" / Interactive Showcase).
2. **Carousel Slider**: Main image showcase with responsive slides, prev/next arrows, and dot indicators.
3. **Footer**: Minimalist footer with copyright and Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
